# v2026.10.2

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.2.md).

OpenClaw 2026.10.2 fixes errors during upgrades from 2026.10.1 and Doctor repairs, addresses missing or repeated replies, and helps long conversations continue, with fixes for credential masking in large tool output.

**Release scale:** 80 pull requests, 12 direct commits, and 107 contributors.

## Installation and Onboarding

- **Node during installation.** Recovery installs use the compatible Node runtime OpenClaw selected even when an older system Node comes first in PATH, avoiding a misleading package-script version error. See the [Node setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node). [#164677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164677), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jarvisnextgeneration20-lang](https://github.com/jarvisnextgeneration20-lang).

## Web UI

- **Dashboard replies.** Chats can answer after a daily or idle reset when background title work previously blocked them. Background commands that delegate and wait also avoid producing the final answer twice. [#162689](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162689), [#166362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166362), thanks to [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star), [@dimonnld](https://github.com/dimonnld), [@OmniScaleMatt](https://github.com/OmniScaleMatt), [@gloria0021](https://github.com/gloria0021), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- **Dictation.** Holding the microphone and releasing it no longer stops recording prematurely. You can keep speaking, then tap Stop to insert the transcript. [#166843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166843), thanks to [@alfredjbclaw](https://github.com/alfredjbclaw) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Opening and reconnecting chats.** Discovering available tools can reuse compatible large plugins already running, avoiding a duplicate load that could freeze the chat and other requests. [#167374](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167374), thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- **Typed stop commands.** In a connected non-global chat, `/stop` clears queued follow-ups as well as active work, so waiting messages do not immediately restart the agent. The Stop button and offline replay still stop only the particular run. See the [chat cancellation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat). [#167860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167860), thanks to [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Updates and Maintenance

- **Upgrading from 2026.10.1.** The first upgrade from published stable 2026.10.1 avoids a cleanup error after replacing the package. Windows upgrades also get past the final plugin check that the older updater could no longer call. [#168849](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168849), [#169031](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169031), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Windows update checks.** Windows updates no longer reject a valid update solely because of how its launcher starts it. Backup checks also recognize short names and different letter casing for the same folder. [#166530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166530), [#168968](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168968), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@wqj11a](https://github.com/wqj11a), [@H0Nm4M1suZu](https://github.com/H0Nm4M1suZu) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Update cleanup.** A fixed CLI no longer reports a missing-module error while cleaning up an update that already succeeded. An older CLI can still show that error during its first upgrade; use the newly installed `openclaw update status` to check the result. See the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update). [#165233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165233), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Update and repair reports.** An update confirmed successful in saved history no longer appears to fail just because OpenClaw cannot display its result. Optional configuration fallback notices now appear as warnings. Repair reports also call out configured chat accounts that remain stopped. Use `openclaw health --json` to investigate those accounts; see the [repair guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). [#169037](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169037), [#165539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165539), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kvnloo](https://github.com/kvnloo), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- **Container file copying.** Updates can copy file bytes when a container blocks file cloning. Affected 2026.9.7 installations need one manual npm installation of a fixed release before later updates can use the repair. Keep native filesystem safeguards enabled and follow the [recovery steps](/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). [#165257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165257), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@MrJanvar](https://github.com/MrJanvar), [@rybing7](https://github.com/rybing7) and [@Mohl](https://github.com/Mohl).
- **Workspace avatars.** Update checks no longer reject valid absolute avatar paths inside your workspace. An older updater may still need a simple workspace-relative path such as `avatar.png` until it has been updated. [#164638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164638), thanks to [@nitinjwadhawan](https://github.com/nitinjwadhawan), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@BottaniCals](https://github.com/BottaniCals).
- **Doctor after container replacement.** After replacing an exited container, Doctor can wait for the previous Gateway's lock to expire and continue repairs. Updates also avoid a false “undergoing offline maintenance” refusal caused by Doctor's own work. If Doctor reports a live Gateway, follow the stop instructions in the [Doctor recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/recovery). [#165355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165355), [#165417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165417), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Linux repair checks.** Timestamp changes on an unchanged database no longer cause false update or recovery refusals. Slow local database checks also avoid a false service-manager timeout before Doctor can stop the Gateway for maintenance. [#165775](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165775), [#168161](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168161), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@donquiche61](https://github.com/donquiche61), [@naturecurly](https://github.com/naturecurly), [@dreamkeeper](https://github.com/dreamkeeper), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666), [@clockthunder](https://github.com/clockthunder), [@honghongxinxi-zhb](https://github.com/honghongxinxi-zhb), [@jayzhou2309](https://github.com/jayzhou2309), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@Tosko4](https://github.com/Tosko4).
- **Older session history.** Doctor can continue repairing leftover session files while keeping current conversation labels and active chats intact. Disputed originals are preserved for recovery; a warning or protected archive does not mean that history was imported or is safe to delete. [329857b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/329857b21e9f01fcd5a399384d4f5231ce6371cd), [80117e8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80117e8cb0c2440e399b3e791b2726adc1644f56), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@coolcoolwcr](https://github.com/coolcoolwcr).
- **Leftover migration files.** Doctor can archive old sender lists for removed channel accounts and continue repairs. Memory-indexing lock files also stop triggering repeated recovery warnings for a healthy database. Damaged files for configured accounts and genuine recovery holds still need attention; see the [migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations). [#167651](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167651), [#166517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166517), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@oshunter](https://github.com/oshunter) and [@noelff](https://github.com/noelff).
- **Restart after refused maintenance.** If an update finds OpenClaw already current but stops the Gateway for maintenance that cannot proceed, it can restart the service once recovery is safe. Maintenance still reports failure. Services you stopped yourself, or those kept stopped because data is at risk, remain stopped. [#166548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166548), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Shirleyyyhk](https://github.com/Shirleyyyhk).

## Messaging

- **Replies during startup.** Messages can wait for their own agent to finish starting, while agents already ready keep answering independently. [#168826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168826), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xiaozishan](https://github.com/xiaozishan) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Telegram previews.** A partial reply stays visible while its replacement is delayed or rejected. The old preview is removed after the replacement is accepted, preserving useful text even when the final send fails. See the [streaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/messaging). [#164649](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164649), thanks to [@jayzhou2309](https://github.com/jayzhou2309), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@jmar5439](https://github.com/jmar5439).
- **Telegram send failures.** A reply blocked locally by unresolved account ownership shows an accurate failure notice instead of an uncertain-delivery warning. The ownership setting may still need correction; see the [channel ownership guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#channel-ownership-during-an-update). [#167470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167470), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@mgr-nick](https://github.com/mgr-nick).
- **Feishu streaming.** Outdated waiting previews can be skipped so the completed answer does not wait behind every earlier version. [#166610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166610), thanks to [@rudycelekli](https://github.com/rudycelekli), [@feie22](https://github.com/feie22), [@cas1per](https://github.com/cas1per), [@L-Trump](https://github.com/L-Trump), [@xiaobao-k8s](https://github.com/xiaobao-k8s) and [@csxjihk](https://github.com/csxjihk).
- **Messages between agents.** Replayed messages retain the original sender label, including when one agent forwards another sender's text, so the receiving agent keeps that context on later turns. [#169130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169130), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).

## Memory

- **Memory recall through Tool Search.** Supported memory searches through Tool Search no longer fail when an agent asks for a score cutoff or a limit on results. [#158632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158632), thanks to [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@he-yufeng](https://github.com/he-yufeng).
- **Summaries before completion replies.** When a long conversation needs a summary, OpenClaw [summarizes its history](/concepts/compaction) before answering a helper result or following up on an approval, without changing the selected model. [#163117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163117), thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@AXEG0](https://github.com/AXEG0) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Corrections during an answer.** With a [durable context engine](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/context-engine), sending a correction while an answer is running no longer causes that completed exchange to be left out of the agent's stored conversation context. [#168394](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168394), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@robertoronderosjr](https://github.com/robertoronderosjr).

## Models and Providers

- **Provider compaction.** Eligible direct OpenAI Responses and Anthropic API-key chats now shorten long conversations with provider-managed checkpoints by default. Anthropic chats can recover on the next turn after the provider rejects an earlier checkpoint. OpenAI manual `/compact` can cost more than a local summary because it processes much more uncached input; see [compaction](/concepts/compaction) and [OpenAI options](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced) for route limits, fallback and opt-outs. [#168164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168164), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Compaction during model cooldowns.** A working configured fallback can summarize a long conversation while the primary credentials cool down after a quota failure, without changing the selected session model. Explicit compaction-model overrides stay exact; see the [compaction guide](/concepts/compaction). [#166459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166459), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hawkit](https://github.com/hawkit).
- **Claude CLI compaction.** Automatic post-turn compaction stays with Claude Code, avoiding an unnecessary Anthropic API-key error and preserving the native conversation connection. Manual `/compact` is a separate path; see [CLI backend guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends). [#162066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162066), thanks to [@rogeriochaves](https://github.com/rogeriochaves), [@llmsommelier](https://github.com/llmsommelier), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@ajmtrz](https://github.com/ajmtrz), [@MaShAn1027](https://github.com/MaShAn1027), [@Jeehut](https://github.com/Jeehut) and [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- **Long Claude CLI replies.** Fixed missing final reports from completed Claude CLI tasks with many streaming updates. [#153545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153545), thanks to [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt), [@methylester](https://github.com/methylester), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc), [@aaajiao](https://github.com/aaajiao), [@telbus](https://github.com/telbus), [@aoclaw-glitch](https://github.com/aoclaw-glitch), [@aikohoshinoai-prog](https://github.com/aikohoshinoai-prog) and [@RTapiador](https://github.com/RTapiador).
- **Claude CLI history.** Imported history avoids duplicating your messages and forwarded input, and preserves who sent them. Recognized background instructions no longer look like messages you wrote, while large tool results appear as tool activity. The updated [CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) explains these display changes and confirms that stored transcripts remain intact. [#163521](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163521), [#166080](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166080), [#168851](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168851), thanks to [@rogeriochaves](https://github.com/rogeriochaves), [@llmsommelier](https://github.com/llmsommelier), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@Peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez), [@IndySweeney](https://github.com/IndySweeney), [@agierror](https://github.com/agierror) and [@Heighte](https://github.com/Heighte).
- **Long ChatGPT subscription replies.** Long ChatGPT subscription replies over HTTP can finish without being cut off by the total amount of streamed data. Individual streaming updates remain size-limited. In native interactive chat over Responses WebSockets, OpenClaw can resume from the saved conversation and continue the answer if a reused connection expires after a reply has begun. [#166853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166853), [#167063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167063), thanks to [@jackten](https://github.com/jackten) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Codex session startup.** Closing idle threads with background terminals no longer blocks later turns. Stalled startup waits can be cancelled and respect their request budget. [#166693](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166693), thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- **Codex provider errors.** A provider failure after tool work remains visible with recovery advice instead of looking merely stopped. Completed actions are not repeated, and an explicit Stop still means cancellation. [#165488](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165488), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Code Mode tasks.** Long Code Mode tasks can keep using tools when a model reuses an earlier request number. Node-command errors also explain how to run a shell command on the intended computer. [#165210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165210), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **OpenAI tool compatibility.** OpenAI replies no longer fail merely because an enabled plugin or MCP tool contains an affected pattern in its input rules, even when that tool is not used. See [advanced provider guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced). [#166999](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166999), thanks to [@scs0209](https://github.com/scs0209), [@adamjgmiller](https://github.com/adamjgmiller) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Local model replies.** Models with strict Chat Completions templates can keep replying after background notices that previously caused a message-format error. [#167309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167309), thanks to [@jlapenna](https://github.com/jlapenna) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Custom Bedrock routes.** Requests using a custom Bedrock provider ID no longer fail before contacting AWS, and use that route's configured region. See the [Bedrock guide](/providers/bedrock) and [custom-provider setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/custom-providers). [#164406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164406), thanks to [@Ayushdevo](https://github.com/Ayushdevo), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@kai-ocean-kurt](https://github.com/kai-ocean-kurt).
- **Local llama.cpp setup.** Setup checks whether the server can run before downloading model files and explains alternatives when it cannot. Managed macOS binaries require 13.3 or later; older Macs can use a working existing or compatible custom server through [local-model service configuration](/gateway/local-model-services). [e0de414](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e0de4147026d54096ace25a4785fa30fb50db575), thanks to [@NovaUnboundAi](https://github.com/NovaUnboundAi), [@xXG0DLessXx](https://github.com/xXG0DLessXx) and [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- **Loading models for saved chats.** Continuing a conversation from the saved-session catalog or changing chat settings no longer hangs indefinitely while loading the model list. A timeout lets you retry without leaving a partially created chat or applying a rejected settings change later. Bulk settings changes still report each chat's result separately. See [session-control guidance](/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control). [#166089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166089), [#166376](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166376), thanks to [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@dprev](https://github.com/dprev).
- **Model-list changes during startup.** A model-list update between startup checks and execution no longer causes the reported refusal to start a chat or scheduled job. [#168410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168410), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Fallback and saved messages.** Automatic fallback can reach another provider after the first attempt was sent, instead of failing before the retry begins. Your saved message stays unchanged. Messages between agents also keep the same text and sender context when first delivered and replayed later. [9def9c1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9def9c191a7d2947194259f010658d83870bbfec), [36f6305](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36f630504df528ad70675238f90e4021cfcea6e0).
- **Claude history caching.** After a large document, image or tool exchange, Claude can still reuse eligible cached earlier conversation history. Bedrock also chooses a caching duration supported by the selected model and profile. See [prompt-caching guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching). [#168042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168042), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Conversation history and caching.** Reopened chats keep the same shortened tool-result text the model saw originally. Browser chats can keep reusing cached conversation text when a helper reports back privately, and Claude caches earlier history without temporary instructions that disappear later. See [prompt-caching guidance](/reference/prompt-caching). [#168392](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168392), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Automations and Scheduling

- **Codex max thinking.** Scheduled and webhook turns honor the existing max-thinking setting when the selected model supports it, instead of silently using its default effort. [#165444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165444), thanks to [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- **Condition checks after restart.** The first scheduled script check after a restart no longer reloads plugins already running, avoiding the resulting timeout and stalls in other Gateway work. See [schedule guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/schedules). [#166991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166991), thanks to [@67-luck](https://github.com/67-luck), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@lucianosmori](https://github.com/lucianosmori).
- **Manually started jobs.** An accepted automation can keep using its allowed tools after the chat turn that started it ends. It uses the job's saved permissions, and disabling or removing the job still stops its work. [#168037](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168037), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Home notifications.** Creating many chats no longer fills Home's notification queue with a separate notice for each one. Recent new chats share one summary, leaving room for reminders and other notices on Home's next turn or heartbeat. See [Home guidance](/concepts/main-session#what-flows-into-the-main-session). [#168239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168239), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Browser and Computer Use

- **Managed browser tabs.** At the shared tab limit, locally managed browser cleanup favors untracked and older pages before recently used session tabs. The oldest eligible session tab can still be removed. [#166666](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166666), thanks to [@ruel225](https://github.com/ruel225), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@vokaplok](https://github.com/vokaplok).

## Plugins and Integrations

- **Plugin approval waits.** Affected plugin tools can wait for your approval for the existing response window instead of being cancelled early as stalled. Unanswered requests still expire; see [permission-request guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/plugin-permission-requests). [#161821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161821), thanks to [@fransqaas](https://github.com/fransqaas) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Long tool conversations.** Affected context-engine plugins keep older history within the model's available space as tools run, avoiding the reported context-limit failure. Oversized new tool output can still exceed the limit. [#166120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166120), thanks to [@ruel225](https://github.com/ruel225), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@igs-rogenlo](https://github.com/igs-rogenlo).
- **Codex model discovery cleanup.** Timed-out model discovery releases abandoned background processes while active sibling work can finish, preventing that source of accumulating memory use. Later work can start a replacement; see [Codex recovery guidance](/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/recovery). [#168365](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168365), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@609NFT](https://github.com/609NFT).

## Security and Privacy

- **Credential masking.** Built-in masking no longer misses recognized credentials split across long tool output. Long or repetitive text also avoids the reported masking freezes and stack overflows, with less processing work under the existing rules. [#161480](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161480), [#166701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166701), thanks to [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **HTTPS commands through the secret proxy.** HTTPS commands using the secret egress proxy no longer fail strict certificate checks with newly generated certificates, including affected Python commands on macOS. After updating, restart the Gateway and start a new command. Keep certificate verification enabled. Retained older debug-proxy certificates are unchanged and can still fail strict checks. [f1cd78c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f1cd78c7ec954542db26ee965adae4fb8baab309), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vortexopenclaw](https://github.com/vortexopenclaw) and [@A1fred-AI](https://github.com/A1fred-AI).

## Quality-of-Life Improvements

- **Configuration errors.** When a helper cannot launch, configuration checks report the actual launch error and affected file instead of an unrelated `trim` error. [#165373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165373), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nnljl2003](https://github.com/nnljl2003).
- **File and console logs.** Masking secrets in file logs and JSON console output uses less temporary memory, with the same masking rules and output. [#167943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167943), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Other Bug Fixes

- **Quoted Windows commands.** Commands on Windows nodes preserve multiword arguments, URLs and executable paths with spaces through the supported command wrapper. [#158160](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158160), thanks to [@Dimitri-lcht](https://github.com/Dimitri-lcht), [@igs-rogenlo](https://github.com/igs-rogenlo), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@kassol](https://github.com/kassol).
- **Rosetta worktree and process checks.** Intel OpenClaw running under Rosetta on Apple silicon uses Git for worktrees and avoids the crashing native process check. Maintenance that needs that process inspection still requires native arm64 Node. [#165088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165088), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Helper answers.** Helpers using ACP or the shared CLI fallback pass their complete new answers back to the main agent, including the end of long reports and the answer for the right task. Delayed older results also stop replacing newer accepted answers. See [announcement guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce). [#165800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165800), [#166139](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166139), thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@potterdigital](https://github.com/potterdigital), [@Leli1024](https://github.com/Leli1024), [@zyz619963502zyz](https://github.com/zyz619963502zyz), [@Yun-0000](https://github.com/Yun-0000) and [@michaeljgood71](https://github.com/michaeljgood71).
- **Replies after helper results.** The main agent can keep working on a helper's result without losing its final reply when the helper's delivery deadline expires. Normal task time limits and Stop still apply; see [handoff guidance](/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff). [#164282](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164282), thanks to [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Background tools.** Tasks no longer get cancelled as stalled after background tools have successfully finished, even if the next model response reaches its output limit. See [queue guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue). [#166997](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166997), thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) and [@hippoley](https://github.com/hippoley).
- **Earlier images.** With an image decoder available, corrupt images are omitted from requests so text follow-ups and reopened conversations can continue. Missing older images also receive a neutral note instead of instructions to deny the assistant's earlier inspection. [#166564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166564), [#166165](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166165), thanks to [@jayzhou2309](https://github.com/jayzhou2309), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@mirasrael](https://github.com/mirasrael) and [@nogikeyaksh](https://github.com/nogikeyaksh).
- **Conversation context on later turns.** Context added to a message by prompt hooks or replacement prompts now stays with that message on later turns and after reopening the chat, while the visible chat keeps your original text. Replies after a helper finishes also keep the main conversation's instructions, reducing repeated prompt processing for affected local models. [#167938](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167938), [#167898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167898), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Eragim](https://github.com/Eragim) and [@apalmiere](https://github.com/apalmiere).
- **Stopped node workers.** Force-stopping a node worker can stop surviving child processes and free its slot for later work once cleanup is verified. See [background-process guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process). [#168746](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168746), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@aniruddhaadak80](https://github.com/aniruddhaadak80) and [@linhongyu510](https://github.com/linhongyu510).

# v2026.10.3
Source: https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.10.3

# v2026.10.3

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.3.md).

OpenClaw 2026.10.3 fixes several update blockers, preserves saved sign-ins and memory files during affected Doctor repairs, and helps the Mac app connect during local setup, with fixes that let conversations continue after compaction or interrupted provider replies.

**Release scale:** 79 pull requests, 8 direct commits, and 97 contributors.

## Updates and Maintenance

- **Blocked updates.** Updates can clear eligible leftover recovery work and archive completed update records that previously blocked the next upgrade. Already-blocked older updaters need the [manual installation or recovery first step](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating#package-publication-recovery); an [independent recovery helper](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating#recover-a-completed-receipt-with-an-older-updater) can preserve the completed record and unblock the original updater. [#168388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168388), [#169038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169038), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@k94118](https://github.com/k94118), [@kimjinsuhh](https://github.com/kimjinsuhh), [@GoldenrodScript](https://github.com/GoldenrodScript), [@neilofneils404](https://github.com/neilofneils404), [@mkdelta221](https://github.com/mkdelta221), [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault), [@clawdgawd](https://github.com/clawdgawd), [@yoyo837](https://github.com/yoyo837), [@lishewen](https://github.com/lishewen), [@nukk-pain](https://github.com/nukk-pain), [@jullianatolentino](https://github.com/jullianatolentino), [@joshpetras](https://github.com/joshpetras) and [@creanet-64](https://github.com/creanet-64).
- **Interrupted 2026.9.8 updates.** The updated CLI can settle supported aborted records that prevented another update. This legacy recovery path warns when package contents could not be rechecked, so keep the recovery evidence and follow the [repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). [#169027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169027), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@chedong](https://github.com/chedong).
- **FreeBSD package recovery.** Recovery helpers produced by the fixed updater can repair or retire interrupted npm package updates on FreeBSD. Older helpers still support status only, and package recovery remains separate from restarting or verifying the Gateway. See the [updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). [#168775](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168775), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Leftover updater copies.** Doctor can remove an eligible abandoned npm updater copy that prevents the next update. Wait for updater workers to finish, run `openclaw doctor --fix` from the affected installation, then retry. Keep the recovery journal and its permissions intact; see [update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting). [#170170](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170170), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/sunnyshu0925) and [@warhangel](https://github.com/warhangel).
- **Candidate checks with older updaters.** A newer candidate is no longer rejected solely because Doctor would update version, setup or migration bookkeeping. Real settings repairs and substantive migrations still follow their existing handling. See the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update). [#170195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170195), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@maestrokling](https://github.com/maestrokling) and [@frxiaobei](https://github.com/frxiaobei).
- **Older Node updaters.** Updates avoid an unnecessary rollback when older and newer update processes measure time differently and mistake a valid update for a lost one. [#169915](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169915), thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- **Updates requested in chat.** Fixed a Doctor cleanup check that falsely refused permission and rolled back chat-requested updates, sometimes leaving plugin upgrades unfinished. [#170218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170218), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph), [@ezimerman](https://github.com/ezimerman), [@yoyo837](https://github.com/yoyo837), [@aia007731-lab](https://github.com/aia007731-lab), [@justinforsound](https://github.com/justinforsound) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Doctor during updates.** Doctor can continue after a later process check fails when it already verified the updater. If recording a newly started command fails, Doctor can clean it up after confirming it stopped, avoiding leftover work that blocks later repairs. [#169563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169563), [#169665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169665), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Windows service accounts.** Updates recognize different Task Scheduler names for the same service account and can restart the Gateway without rewriting a service owned by somebody else. See the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update). [#169481](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169481), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Windows update and recovery paths.** Updater workers recognize short names and different capitalization for the same installation folder. Recovery snapshots also stop rejecting their own Windows temporary directory. The path correction requires the fixed updater to be installed before it starts the upgrade. [#169292](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169292), [#169397](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169397), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **pnpm service commands.** New or repaired Gateway service commands use pnpm's durable installation link, so replacing a versioned package folder does not break them. Update planning also recognizes installations reached through nested pnpm paths. Existing commands pinned to an old folder need repair or replanning; see [update methods](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods). [#170003](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170003), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint) and [@k-sekula](https://github.com/k-sekula).
- **pnpm 12 launchers.** Fixed native pnpm updates keep the `openclaw` command usable after staging cleanup, including with a symlinked global bin folder. The updater must already contain this fix. Already-broken commands need manual repair or a [same-version pnpm reinstall](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods#alternative-manual-npm-pnpm-or-bun) after backup, using the same account and global directories. [#170131](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170131), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@goutamadwant](https://github.com/goutamadwant) and [@k-sekula](https://github.com/k-sekula).
- **Service refresh refusals.** An update can restart the preserved Gateway service after safely refusing to rewrite its definition. Restart still requires the existing definition and service ownership to pass revalidation, preserving customizations. See [how updates run](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run). [#169658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169658), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Busy state databases.** Optional progress logging no longer aborts an update solely because the database is briefly busy, and update-history writes spend less time blocking Gateway work. Required recovery writes remain mandatory. These driver-side improvements require the fixed updater to start the upgrade; see the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update). [#168210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168210), [#169283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169283), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jlapenna](https://github.com/jlapenna) and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- **Unrelated dependency copying.** Updates avoid copying dependencies from unrelated enclosing installations and scanning unrelated npm-global tools. The updater starting the upgrade must already contain these fixes; see the [updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). [#168927](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168927), [#169551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169551), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@goutamadwant](https://github.com/goutamadwant) and [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).
- **Configured update memory limits.** Update commands using captured service settings retain configured Node memory limits, including memory-only overrides from your shell. This requires the fixed updater to be installed before the upgrade starts; see the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update). [#168889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168889), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@bluet](https://github.com/bluet).
- **Repair outcomes and next steps.** Unfinished Doctor maintenance is reported as pending with a useful next action. Failures after data migration also point to the supported repair command. Keep the new installation and recovery snapshots, and follow warnings to keep the Gateway stopped while repair workers remain unsettled. See [update repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-repair). [#167714](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167714), [#168905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168905), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ruicozibon](https://github.com/ruicozibon) and [@ezimerman](https://github.com/ezimerman).
- **Update handoff reports.** An already reported update outcome no longer produces a second misleading failure, and an update accepted by the background helper stays pending. Use the printed status and health commands to check its eventual result; see [restart handoff](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run#restart-handoff). [#168587](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168587), [#168993](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168993), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sayitfast](https://github.com/sayitfast).
- **Update warning details.** Recovery-copy warnings identify the affected database, while a failed candidate configuration read explains the error and leaves the service definition unchanged. See [recovery captures](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#original-state-captures) and the [updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). [#169282](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169282), [#169284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169284), thanks to [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Git update cleanup.** Temporary worktree cleanup continues when progress reporting fails, and the original update error remains visible alongside secondary diagnostics. If OpenClaw cannot confirm that update processes stopped, it keeps the recovery files and refuses to continue. This requires the fixed installed updater; see the [repair guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). [#169454](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169454), thanks to [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- **Migration warnings and verification timers.** Completed plugin migrations stop showing obsolete unfinished warnings. Package verification also keeps its deadline when the system clock changes. Genuine pending migrations still need attention; see the [repair guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). [#169004](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169004), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@adenzhou1350](https://github.com/adenzhou1350) and [@wg-mojo](https://github.com/wg-mojo).
- **Recovery copies before repairs.** New recovery copies include older Canvas documents and Memory Core files before migration. Doctor and update recovery no longer reject a copy because scheduled background database maintenance changes files while it is being made. Update checks also work when the configured agent list is empty. Existing copies do not gain missing files retroactively. [#169436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169436), [#170022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170022), [c01331a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c01331a76beb292d1c05f22409c71a20c5cc9085), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Messaging

- **Channel tools after restart.** Messaging accounts started or restarted by a chat or operator task keep using channel tools after that task finishes, with each later turn's permissions still enforced. [#159396](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159396), thanks to [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@slinkoff](https://github.com/slinkoff), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and [@sjf-oa](https://github.com/sjf-oa).
- **Messages already being sent.** Recovery scanning leaves a message with its active sender, preventing the reported race that left queued messages unsent. [#169010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169010), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Steered conversations after restart.** Human conversations can resume after a correction and Gateway restart when their original authorized source survives. Already-failed sessions are not reopened, and missing sender permissions are not reconstructed. See [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). [#170252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170252), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Memory

- **Memory-file repairs.** Doctor preserves the original bytes when malformed UTF-8 prevents merging `MEMORY.md` and the older `memory.md`. Keep the originals or preserved archive, and repair or convert a copy to UTF-8 before retrying. See [workspace repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/workspace-and-dreams). [#169029](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169029), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).

## Native Apps

- **On this Mac setup.** The Mac app can connect in eligible “On this Mac” setups that previously failed with “Gateway rejected auth”, with less unnecessary preparation and waiting. If a required new token cannot be saved, setup stops with a retryable error. See the [bundled Gateway guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/mac/bundled-gateway). [#169403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169403), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- **Mac reconnection after renewal.** The Mac app reconnects automatically after a trusted Gateway certificate renewal. Learned fingerprints can renew after normal trust checks; explicitly configured fingerprints stay fixed. See [remote connection guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/mac/remote). [#168151](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168151), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- **Mac update and recovery checks.** The app recognizes its protected Bun Gateway command, addressing a cause of a stuck recovery screen despite a healthy Gateway. The protective launch option and ownership checks remain in place. [#170006](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170006), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jokerman1302-eng](https://github.com/jokerman1302-eng), [@davidmackrory-byte](https://github.com/davidmackrory-byte) and [@josephsilvagnoli](https://github.com/josephsilvagnoli).

## Models and Providers

- **Muse Wonder.** Meta users can select Muse Wonder with text and image input and max thinking. Spark 1.3 Standard also supports max thinking and remains the setup default. The API supports Wonder Standard; max effort does not select Wonder Full. See the [Meta guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/meta). [#170232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170232), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview.** Eligible Token Plan or MiniMax Code users can select the preview model and choose low, medium, high, xhigh or max thinking effort. The preview defaults to max, including saved off or adaptive selections. M3 remains the default model. Missing published catalog rates do not mean free use; see the [MiniMax guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/minimax). [#160089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160089), thanks to [@NianJiuZst](https://github.com/NianJiuZst), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman), [@php737](https://github.com/php737), [@ns-spec](https://github.com/ns-spec), [@Hansen1018](https://github.com/Hansen1018) and [@olveww-dot](https://github.com/olveww-dot).
- **MiniMax sign-in renewal.** Global and CN OAuth sign-ins renew expired tokens at their issuing regional account endpoint. Older saved sign-ins and region changes require one new login with `openclaw models auth login --provider minimax-portal`. See the [MiniMax guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/minimax). [#160459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160459), thanks to [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@rongtianhua](https://github.com/rongtianhua) and [@mychataa](https://github.com/mychataa).
- **Replies after native compaction.** The next message waits for saved conversation history to become readable instead of failing while that history is rebuilding. See [OpenAI guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced). [#169583](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169583), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Interrupted ChatGPT replies.** An unfinished ChatGPT reply can continue from the saved conversation when a normal connection close interrupts it, within the existing retry limits. See [model failover guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover). [#167512](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167512), thanks to [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@mightyx](https://github.com/mightyx) and [@aleps001](https://github.com/aleps001).
- **Codex follow-up messages.** Compatible follow-ups can continue after failed conversation preparation while an existing background command keeps running. Incompatible permission or policy changes remain refused while protected work runs. [#169431](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169431), thanks to [@jjjhenriksen](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Switching back to OpenAI.** OpenAI models can use the existing built-in runtime when Codex is disabled and that runtime can run them. An explicitly configured Codex runtime still needs the Codex plugin enabled. [#169412](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169412), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **Claude CLI tool discovery.** Claude CLI receives the registered OpenClaw tool names and guidance for replies that must be sent through a tool, reducing failed lookups. This guidance applies to tools actually available to the conversation. See the [CLI backend guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends). [#153032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153032), thanks to [@kiranvk-2011](https://github.com/kiranvk-2011), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@lakemike](https://github.com/lakemike), [@philknows](https://github.com/philknows), [@destinedenergy](https://github.com/destinedenergy) and [@wbumgardner-max](https://github.com/wbumgardner-max).
- **Claude CLI session tools.** Later turns keep their authorized session, history and admin tools after the turn that started the shared connection ends. Each caller retains its own permissions and revocation checks. See the [CLI backend guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends). [#165432](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165432), thanks to [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333), [@Leit-motif](https://github.com/Leit-motif), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@XX441](https://github.com/XX441), [@aaajiao](https://github.com/aaajiao), [@alexph-dev](https://github.com/alexph-dev), [@Claynetic](https://github.com/Claynetic), [@N4DH](https://github.com/N4DH), [@Jeehut](https://github.com/Jeehut), [@S1gv4rd](https://github.com/S1gv4rd), [@arifarai](https://github.com/arifarai), [@davidevelyn](https://github.com/davidevelyn), [@marl0n](https://github.com/marl0n) and [@Mydudeclaps](https://github.com/Mydudeclaps).
- **Copilot prompt capacity.** Models with missing native limits can use the account's reported prompt capacity instead of the 128K estimate, while real limits and configured caps remain effective. Refresh discovery to replace previously cached estimates. [#156636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156636), thanks to [@saju01](https://github.com/saju01), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@snotty](https://github.com/snotty), [@vinaycodeaxe](https://github.com/vinaycodeaxe), [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) and [@Yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx).
- **DeepSeek replies and tool actions.** Recognized internal tool markup stays out of replies, and managed turns can recover valid marked-up tool actions, including the `calls` wrapper. Direct provider calls and final replies filter the markup without recovering tools; malformed or unfinished recognized blocks stay hidden without execution. See the [DeepSeek guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/deepseek). [#169728](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169728), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@TOMUIV](https://github.com/TOMUIV).
- **IPv6 provider fallback.** Guarded model requests can try a working IPv6 address when IPv4 is unreachable and Node address-family autoselection is enabled. Configured network security checks still apply. See [connectivity troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/local-models#troubleshooting). [#168973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168973), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@an2in](https://github.com/an2in), [@georgenaz](https://github.com/georgenaz), [@motookoyama](https://github.com/motookoyama) and [@orthogonalistic](https://github.com/orthogonalistic).

## Automations and Scheduling

- **Unchanged one-shot jobs.** Doctor stops making redundant recovery copies for one-shot jobs whose saved timestamps are already correct. Genuine repairs keep their backup protections. [#168938](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168938), thanks to [@harshitgupta31415](https://github.com/harshitgupta31415) and [@wg-mojo](https://github.com/wg-mojo).

## Plugins and Integrations

- **Blocked local plugin settings.** Doctor and updates preserve enablement, settings and policy for installed or linked plugins blocked by a path safety check. The plugin stays blocked until its path is repaired; see [blocked-plugin guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#blocked-local-plugins). [#168111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168111), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- **oc-path file edits.** The opt-in oc-path plugin refuses `openclaw path set` edits on invalid UTF-8 before rewriting the file, preserving the original bytes. Back up and repair or convert the file before retrying. [#168491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168491), thanks to [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666), [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) and [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- **Webhook callbacks during upgrades.** Existing official webhook-channel callbacks can be preserved before a deferred plugin replacement is activated, including the affected Microsoft Teams path. Authored callbacks and opt-outs remain respected; see [webhook migration guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#channel-webhook-listeners). [#169035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169035), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sirius1024](https://github.com/sirius1024).
- **Native plugin catalogs.** Catalog changes avoid repeatedly loading an unchanged installed native plugin, removing that source of growing memory use. After a failed refresh, the next request can use its requested configuration. [#169272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169272), [#169321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169321), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@mcooks-cmd](https://github.com/mcooks-cmd), [@svdinu-jpg](https://github.com/svdinu-jpg), [@eduherranz](https://github.com/eduherranz) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Commands on paired nodes.** An unchanged connected node keeps handling commands, requests and events while unrelated pairing information is updated or another device's pairing is being written. Actual revocation and token rotation still reject the old connection. [#169486](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169486), [#169575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169575), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@gisk0](https://github.com/gisk0).
- **Codex plugin compatibility.** Official external Codex packages older than 2026.9.7 are reported unavailable before they break replies. Eligible official updates follow the core release, and failures show useful reasons. Use `openclaw update repair` or `openclaw plugins update codex`; linked copies need their source updated or load-path override removed. Finish Doctor before restarting when migrations are pending. See [plugin update guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update). [#170306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170306), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ezimerman](https://github.com/ezimerman).
- **Plugin package repairs.** A replacement package can be saved while its data migration is unfinished, allowing Doctor to continue. **Finish `openclaw doctor --fix` before restarting or reloading the replacement.** Unavailable automatically selected official ClawHub versions can use trusted same-version npm packages, or keep compatible installed code with a retry warning. Removing the plugin's entry preserves its backup and pending migration obligations. See the [updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). [#170339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170339), thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@h6y3](https://github.com/h6y3), [@CodeForcer](https://github.com/CodeForcer), [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault) and [@rauf543](https://github.com/rauf543).

## Security and Privacy

- **Saved sign-ins during Doctor repairs.** An unreadable legacy auth file no longer causes the affected cleanup to discard saved OAuth profiles. Doctor identifies the file to inspect or restore before retrying, while unrelated repairs can continue. Previously deleted profiles and retired credential imports are not restored. See [Doctor state recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions). [#170256](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170256), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nosmile99](https://github.com/nosmile99).

## Quality-of-Life Improvements

- **Restart with an unreachable cloud worker.** The Gateway can stop or restart while deferring the stop of an unreachable stored cloud worker and reporting that deferral. The remote machine is not immediately stopped or deleted; later cleanup remains required. [#168907](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168907), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

## Other Bug Fixes

- **Deleting an unfinished conversation.** Deleting a session records cancellation before stopping its unfinished reply, allowing chat clients to receive the cancelled status. [e115a6a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e115a6ac739eb5a86292c177f1886115ea0cbb3a).

# v2026.10.4
Source: https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.10.4

# v2026.10.4

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.4.md).

OpenClaw v2026.10.4 fixes update and recovery problems, including interrupted work after sleep or clock changes and chats stuck after an update, alongside repairs for messaging, model tools and sign-in.

**Release scale:** 55 pull requests, 24 direct commits, and 49 contributors.

## Web UI

- **Chat refresh after updates.** Chats stuck on “Server updated” can refresh back to the same conversation link. If your tab was open before updating, save unsaved work and reload it once to load this fix.

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#168941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168941), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  </details>

- **Dashboard connection.** Open dashboards can stay connected when a busy Gateway delays its check-in messages, avoiding unnecessary reconnects. Requests still have their own timeouts.

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#171253](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171253), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  </details>

## Updates and Maintenance

- **Sleep and clock changes.** Fixed unnecessary interruptions after computer sleep or backward clock changes, with clearer [restart guidance](/gateway/restart-recovery) when OpenClaw loses access to its saved state.

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#170790](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170790), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jjjhenriksen](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen), [@AnvinaLI](https://github.com/AnvinaLI), [@sgh6688](https://github.com/sgh6688), [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault), [@andersgreg](https://github.com/andersgreg) and [@shawnholt](https://github.com/shawnholt).

  </details>

- **Gateway shutdown.** Stopping or restarting OpenClaw no longer hangs on stalled conversation indexing, and pending session updates can finish before connected clients close. Saved transcripts remain available after a [restart](/gateway/restart-recovery).

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#170493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170493), [#170555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170555), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) and [@O96a](https://github.com/O96a).

  </details>

- **Old login files.** Unused retired OAuth files no longer block Doctor, updates or Docker startup, and remain preserved. Referenced files still need the documented [2026.9.7 recovery on the original host](/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#retention-policy).

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#165420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165420), thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

  </details>

- **Update snapshots.** After installing 10.4, later upgrades avoid false warnings that an unchanged database changed while its recovery copy was made. Real later changes can still prevent [automatic restoration](/install/updating/rollback-and-recovery).

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#170351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170351), thanks to [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).

  </details>

- **Updates after data migration.** Update checks avoid false verification failures after data migration. Status also stops repeating a saved restart warning once the running Gateway reports the expected version. See [rollback and recovery](/install/updating/rollback-and-recovery).

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#170130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170130), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@angeliti999](https://github.com/angeliti999).

  </details>

- **Temporary update files.** Doctor and updates can remove abandoned temporary update directories despite unrelated system processes, including ordinary Linux systemd user sessions. Directories still used by live OpenClaw processes remain protected.

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#166335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166335), [#171488](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171488), thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).

  </details>

- **Temporary disk use.** Update checks reuse eligible prepared database copies instead of duplicating them again, and give clearer retry guidance for space failures.

  <details class="release-source-toggle release-source-inline">
  <summary>More details</summary>

  [#167451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167451), thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@iFadi](https://github.com/iFadi), [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization), [@azuretek](https://github.com/azuretek) and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini).

- **Maintenance warnings.** Completed plugin upgrades stop leaving stale “unfinished” warnings in [update history](/cli/update/status-and-history). Expected database maintenance also stops producing false checkpoint-failure warnings.

# v2026.6.11
Source: https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.6.11

_Released 2026-06-30._

We heard the feedback. v2026.6.11 focuses on the rough edges that make OpenClaw feel less dependable, with fixes for misplaced replies, stuck sends, reconnects, model setup failures, and safer admin defaults.

## Highlights

### Channel delivery reliability

Across [Telegram](/channels/telegram), [WhatsApp](/channels/whatsapp), [Matrix](/channels/matrix), [Google Chat](/channels/googlechat), [iMessage](/channels/imessage), [Feishu](/channels/feishu), and [Mattermost](/channels/mattermost), replies, commands, queued messages, and attachments are less likely to be dropped, duplicated, misrouted, or attached to the wrong conversation.

Sources and contributors

- Fixes newer Google Chat direct messages sometimes being treated like group conversations, so they reach the correct one-to-one chat while Space and group-chat messages keep their existing routing. [#58993](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/58993) Thanks @starhappysh, @vincentkoc.
- Feishu voice replies from OpenClaw now show their duration in the chat bubble, so recipients can see how long the audio is before playing it. [#89172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89172) Related [#53798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53798). Thanks @areslp, @fxz26284407, @kinrocw.
- Discord and Telegram replies and mirrored chat history stay tied to the intended conversation more consistently, including across repeated Telegram replies and session changes. [#89911](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89911) Thanks @jalehman.
- Background image, video, and music results now return to the chat that requested them when the task starts without a full conversation target, instead of appearing to fail after creation or being sent to the wrong peer as the session moves. [#89949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89949) Related [#86034](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86034). Thanks @tianxiaochannel-oss88, @wangwllu.
- Telegram answers now stay attached to the user's current question when they quote an earlier bot message, while quotes of other people's messages still reply to the selected quote. [#90475](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90475) Thanks @moeedahmed.
- QQBot group admins can choose how broadly slash commands are available, and private-only commands now direct users to a private chat instead of being exposed or silently ignored in groups. [#92154](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92154) Thanks @sliverp.
- Heartbeat checks using reasoning-capable models now show the assistant's intended reply instead of exposing internal reasoning in Telegram, WhatsApp, and other channels, while opt-in Thinking messages still work. [#92356](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92356) Related [#92260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92260). Thanks @jmpei, @tangtaizong666, @vincentkoc.

### Provider and model recovery

[Model selection](/providers/models) and setup recover more clearly when catalogs, credentials, streams, timeouts, compaction, or fallbacks go wrong. Affected [OpenAI](/providers/openai), [OpenRouter](/providers/openrouter), and [OpenCode Go](/providers/opencode-go) configurations now report or recover from failures more consistently instead of leaving users with a stale choice or a stalled request.

Follow-up fixes for [fast mode](/tools/thinking#fast-mode-%2Ffast) improve its behavior in affected provider and fallback paths; automatic fast mode itself is not new in this release.

Sources and contributors

- MiniMax text-to-speech and voice notes are less likely to fail because OpenClaw now explicitly requests the audio format it can decode instead of relying on provider defaults. [#73079](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73079) Thanks @efe-arv.
- Gateway operators can again see provider, model, request status, and timing details in normal logs, making model-routing and transport problems easier to diagnose without enabling extra debug logging. [#89648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89648) Related [#89300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89300). Thanks @enominera, @xiaobao-k8s.
- Models reached through Google, Mistral, OpenAI Responses, Azure OpenAI Responses, and ChatGPT/Codex Responses now receive clean system instructions without OpenClaw's internal cache-boundary marker leaking into the prompt. [#89716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89716) Thanks @enominera, @masatohoshino.
- Cron tool calls using Gemini models through OpenAI-compatible providers now run without nullable fields triggering provider schema rejections. ### Session, memory, and trust continuity

[Sessions](/concepts/session), [compaction](/concepts/compaction), [memory](/concepts/memory), and [QMD-backed memory](/concepts/memory-qmd) preserve the intended conversation and useful context more consistently through long-running work, reconnects, upgrades, and transcript repair. [Tool search](/tools/tool-search) also behaves more reliably when agents need to recover the right context or capability.

Encrypted [Matrix](/channels/matrix) recovery stops safely when required key state cannot be verified. [Tool policies](/gateway/sandbox-vs-tool-policy-vs-elevated), [approvals](/cli/approvals), and [secret handling](/gateway/secrets) stay attached to the intended runtime state, with higher-risk actions remaining disabled unless explicitly enabled.

Sources and contributors

- Affected agent conversations using OpenAI Responses can now recover and keep replying after a visible channel response leaves their saved history incomplete, instead of every later turn failing before a reply appears. [#84708](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84708) Thanks @anyech.
- When a Codex-backed agent produces unusually large tool output, saved and replayed conversations now keep its text within the usual size limit while leaving non-text content unchanged. [#87912](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87912) Thanks @adrianip0204.
- Control UI conversations now stay visible and continue in the same session after a sleep, network drop, or Gateway reconnect instead of disappearing when the next message is sent. [#89017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89017) Related [#87700](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87700). Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @asicoe.
- Bundled Codex and Copilot integrations now keep mirrored chat history and transcript updates tied to the correct OpenClaw session as storage evolves, while existing file-backed active transcripts continue working during the migration. [#89518](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89518) Thanks @jalehman.
- WebChat's current-session status now matches the conversation you are actually using, so the session identity, thinking level, token context, and cost details no longer come from the fallback `main` session. [#89800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89800) Related [#89773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89773). Thanks @killo3967, @sweetcornna.

- Slack operators can now store tokens and signing secrets as supported SecretRef inputs, while reads, writes, allowlist and target lookups, and setup checks use the resolved credentials instead of rejecting or misreading the references. [7da955f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7da955fae4ca2083599aa33a1f93dbfff53cb187) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Channel capability checks now return a clear timeout when an integration stops responding, keeping troubleshooting from hanging in a terminal or automation run. [8ecdb97](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8ecdb97b636e4c3fcc6d142d217327404ae06581) Thanks @vincentkoc.

## Gateway, Security, and Trust

### Restart and readiness recovery

[Gateway health](/gateway/health) and [troubleshooting](/gateway/troubleshooting) signals now line up more consistently with whether OpenClaw is actually ready, restarting, or unable to continue. Agent runs started through the [CLI](/cli/agent) recover more cleanly from disconnects, shutdowns, routing changes, and failed startup conditions.

Sources and contributors

- When a configured or explicit remote gateway is slow but reachable, `openclaw gateway probe --timeout ...` now waits for the requested timeout instead of reporting it unreachable after a shorter internal cutoff. [#89859](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89859) Related [#65355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/65355). Thanks @hellocli, @mushuiyu886.
- Long or parallel internal subagent runs now avoid unnecessary live-preview processing, while visible subagent sessions still show live updates and final responses. [#91906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91906) Thanks @lanzhi-lee, @vincentkoc.
- ACP conversations, especially Kiro-backed threads, now continue past the first reply by starting a fresh session when the backend can no longer resume the old one. [#93547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93547) Related [#87830](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87830). Thanks @amersheeny, @chouzz.
- When Linux memory pressure kills a child command or session, systemd-managed OpenClaw gateways now stay running and keep channel connections alive while reporting the child failure. [#93585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93585) Thanks @snowzlm.
- Canceling an OpenClaw run during tool work now ends it promptly instead of starting another model turn or leaving the session locked. [#94412](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94412) Thanks @szsip239, @vincentkoc.
- Scheduled OpenClaw jobs using cloud models now recover from silent, stuck model calls by default, helping prevent later cron work from backing up while local or self-hosted providers keep their existing timeout behavior. [#94445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94445) Thanks @bek91.
- Gateway readiness checks now turn unhealthy during a restart drain, preventing traffic managers from sending new work to a Gateway that is temporarily rejecting requests. [#94915](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94915) Related [#78136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78136). Thanks @markoub, @maxschachere, @vincentkoc.
- Mac users can keep LaunchAgent-managed gateways running through OpenClaw upgrades instead of seeing repeated crash-and-restart loops when older text-transform runtime code is still cached. [#95081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95081) Related [#95057](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95057). Thanks @849261680, @yveslarose.

- Long responses, busy tool streams, image-heavy requests, and memory recall now incur less CPU and filesystem overhead without requiring settings or workflow changes. [#95697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95697) Thanks @vincentkoc.
